title: Total Circuit
description: 3-round circuit blending jump squats, incline push-ups, plank and V-ups for a complete full-body burn

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral movements, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Toe taps (step)
exercises.instructions: Tap the foot on a step alternating quickly

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: On the forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace the abs

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Advance in continuous lunges with a big step

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch the feet

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
